protocol.claim_boundary: sampled local-linear response radius at fresh reachable states with native precision controls; no universal stability ball, chaos, evidence-code, memory-use or causal-channel claim
protocol.comparison: all signed direction/radius/horizon cells retained; summarize precision-valid fraction and local-linearity error within each seed/radius/horizon; no selected-radius inference
protocol.curvature_error: norm(G64(xpert)-G64(x)-J64(x)*delta_eff), relative to induced float64 response norm
protocol.direction_construction: float64 isotropic normal vector from RNG(model_seed*10000+direction_seed), normalized once to global L2=1; same directions across anchors/horizons; both signs
protocol.falsifier: precision-valid cells exceed0.1 relative curvature error; precision-limited cells do not establish nonlinear fragility
protocol.independent_unit: four fresh parameter seeds; fixed anchors/directions/signs/radii/horizons dependent within seed
protocol.input_representability: effective L2 radius/requested radius and fraction of native32 coordinates actually changed
protocol.precision_floor: max(norm(G32(xpert)-q32(G64(xpert))), norm(G32(x)-q32(G64(x))), 1e-12); conservative absolute arithmetic floor
protocol.reference: local full-state JVP at each predeclared reachable A anchor, not at mixed-history centroid; this is a new radius question, not recovery of earlier fixed-centroid gates
protocol.response_validity: effective perturbation nonzero and norm(G64(xpert)-G64(x)) >=10*precision_floor; otherwise precision-limited/inconclusive
protocol.sanity: native32 baseline G_h(x) must exactly match independently replayed full public history for each anchor/horizon
protocol.transition: identical model seed weights and blank-input sequence; reset runtime index38 and frozen/trace state inside every native32/float64/JVP evaluation
